crossRefs.note: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
“For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will…
I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all…
Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

translations.web: It will happen in that day, I will respond,” says Yahweh, “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth;
translations.bsb: “On that day I will respond—” declares the LORD— “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will answer, saith Jehovah, I will answer the heavens, and they shall answer the earth;
